verdict.rationale: Notte documents an API with Bearer-token auth, an official CLI, and Python SDK-style usage (BaseModel scraping examples), plus a Playwright/CDP integration and MCP server for agent access — indicating official SDK-like tooling exists. However, there's no dedicated 'SDK' page or language-specific SDK docs, no OpenAPI spec is discoverable (404s), and community feedback questions real-world reliability of the underlying automation. Missing for 10: explicit multi-language SDK documentation, published OpenAPI/API reference beyond auth, and independent verification of SDK usage in production.
